title: 第1章 都穿越了，肯定暴打渣男
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
路仙瑶是名悲催的牛马打工人，苦兮兮地加班到晚上十点就算了，回家的路上，还被车给撞了。

    她睁眼就发现自己穿越了，身旁站着名容貌俊美的男子，周身清冷贵气，高不可攀。

    “呵……”

    男人轻蔑一笑，语气讽刺至极，“路仙瑶，既然你受了惜惜一掌，那你与惜惜便两清了，玄天灵参，拿来！”

    这理直气壮的台词……

    她大概知道这B是谁了。

    原主舔的狗，云鹤珏。

    通过原主的记忆，她大约知道了自己穿到哪了。

    她脚下的这片大地名为神隐。

    如其名，诸神陨落的末法时代。

    虽是末法时代，但这片土地依旧出不少能人，让凡人也能踏上修仙大道，并肩天神。

    而原主是中州瑶池圣地的西王母之女，名为路仙瑶，与她同名同姓。

    加上又是罕见的可吸纳天地灵气的元灵体，自小备受宠爱。

    许是日子过得顺风顺水惯了，就想找点爱情的苦吃一吃。

    二十年前。

    原主受邀随母亲路雪鸢去参加天圣城的星光盛会时，对代表天鸣剑宗出席的云鹤珏一见钟情。

    对云鹤绝死缠烂打，各种法宝灵植丹药送到手软，丢尽瑶池圣地颜面。

    然而，得到的只有云鹤绝的冷眼相待。

    后来，她经过调查才知道，云鹤绝心系的，从来只有他的师妹阮惜惜。

    这可把原主给气得连夜找人重伤阮惜惜，还划伤她的脸，令她修为跌落。

    那云鹤珏可不就对原主更加恨之入骨？

    哪里还会喜欢她？

    任凭原主如何道歉，云鹤绝就是不搭理她，原主便以为肯定是她身边九个炉鼎的存在，他才不愿搭理自己的。

    于是，为了不让他误会，原主不仅带着自己九个炉鼎去天鸣剑宗，当着众人的面，给云鹤珏下跪道歉，并说她会解除契约，还捧上极品药材万年玄天灵参，只求云鹤绝不要不理她。

    然，云鹤珏只要她受阮惜惜一掌。

    原主才明白，云鹤绝不愿搭理自己，是因为她伤了他心爱的师妹。

    要她受情敌一掌，这比杀了她还难受。

    但为了得到云鹤珏原谅，原主硬生生受了这一掌，结果一命呜呼。
content_en:
Lu Xianyao was a miserable laborer who worked overtime until ten o'clock in the evening. On the way home, he was hit by a car.

    When she opened her eyes, she found that she had traveled through time. Standing next to her was a handsome man with a cold, noble air that was unattainable.

    "Heh..."

    The man smiled contemptuously and said in an extremely sarcastic tone, "Lu Xianyao, since you have been slapped by Xixi, then you and Xixi are now separated. Bring Xuantian Spirit Ginseng!"

    Such a confident line...

    She probably knows who this B is.

    The original owner licked the dog, Yun Hejue.

    Through the memory of the original owner, she roughly knew where she had worn it.

    The land beneath her feet is called Shenyin.

    As the name suggests, it is the end of the Dharma era when the gods fall.

    Although it is the age of the Dharma End, this land still produces many capable people, allowing ordinary people to embark on the path of cultivating immortals and stand side by side with the gods.

    The original owner is the daughter of the Queen Mother of the West in the Yaochi Holy Land in Zhongzhou, named Lu Xianyao, who has the same name as her.

    Coupled with the rare Yuanling body that can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, he has been favored since childhood.

    Maybe I'm used to having a smooth life, and I just want to find some love.

    twenty years ago.

    When the original owner was invited to attend the Starlight Gala in Tiansheng City with his mother Lu Xueyuan, he fell in love at first sight with Yun Hejue, who was attending on behalf of the Tianming Sword Sect.

    He stalked Yunhe relentlessly, and sent all kinds of magic weapons, spiritual plants, and elixirs to his mercy, which completely disgraced the Yaochi Holy Land.

    However, all he got was a cold look from Yun Hejue.

    Later, after investigation, she found out that the only person Yun Hejue cared about was his junior sister Ruan Xixi.

    This made the original owner so angry that she spent the whole night looking for someone to seriously injure Ruan Xixi, and even scratched her face, causing her cultivation to plummet.

    Doesn't Yun Hejue hate the original owner even more?

    How could I still like her?

    No matter how much the original owner apologized, Yun Hejue just ignored her. The original owner thought that it must be the existence of the nine cauldrons around her that made him unwilling to pay attention to her.

    Therefore, in order to prevent him from misunderstanding, the original owner not only took his nine cauldrons to the Tianming Sword Sect, but also knelt down and apologized to Yun Hejue in front of everyone, saying that she would terminate the contract. He also offered the top-quality medicinal material Ten Thousand Years Xuantian Spirit Ginseng, and only asked Yun He to never ignore her.

    However, Yun Hejue only wanted her to receive one slap from Ruan Xixi.

    Only then did the original owner realize that Yun He never wanted to talk to him because she hurt his beloved junior sister.

    It would be worse for her to be slapped by a love rival than to kill her.

    But in order to get Yun Hejue's forgiveness, the original owner took the palm forcefully and died.
title_en: Chapter 1: He has traveled through time, and he will definitely beat up the scumbag
